about: Fare rules for standard public bus service in Abu Dhabi, Al Ain and Al Dhafra.
note: Requirements read from the official Abu Dhabi Mobility page on the checked date. This is a fare page rather than a form, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

fees: Children aged 10 and under travel free
timing: No second boarding fee when transferring between public transport services, but inter-city services are not included
